## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the affected package or adapter.

## Verification

- [ ] Lint passed
- [ ] Typecheck passed
- [ ] Tests passed
- [ ] Build passed
- [ ] Release package check passed when release behavior or metadata changed

## Safety and scope

- [ ] Tests and fixtures are deterministic and do not require a live website
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, personal data, customer data, or production captures are included
- [ ] Platform-specific behavior remains inside its source adapter
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs were updated when behavior or boundaries changed
- [ ] The change is authorized and respects source-platform policies
